description: Implementation of network selector functionalities and event handling for WAN management, including starting network detection, updating network selector state, setting WAN modes, and module initialization.

methods.name: network_selector_start
methods.description: Starts network detection by reading WAN data model and invoking 'detect-network' function in 'mod-network-selector'.

methods.name: _update_network_selector
methods.description: Handles network selector updates based on event data, toggling start flags.

methods.name: network_selector_set_wan_mode
methods.description: Sets the WAN mode based on provided alias and current mode, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: register_core_functions
methods.description: Registers core functions like 'set-wan-mode' in the module.

methods.name: mod_network_selector_init
methods.description: Initializes the network selector module by registering core functions.
